discovery.business_context: A synthetic small retail marketing team wants to reduce campaign rework before content production starts.

prd.title: AI Campaign Brief Assistant
prd.problem_statement: Marketing coordinators lack a consistent way to capture audience, ownership and acceptance criteria before work begins.
goals: Capture the minimum evidence needed for a reviewable campaign brief
Make ownership and acceptance criteria visible before production
non_goals: Publish campaigns or change live advertising budgets
Claim validated market demand or measured commercial impact

requirements.title: Guided campaign intake
requirements.user_story: As a marketing coordinator, I want required audience, channel and objective fields so that the production team receives a complete brief.
acceptance_criteria: Submission is blocked when audience, channel or objective is blank
The review page shows the originating evidence IDs

requirements.title: Named approval owner and acceptance criteria
requirements.user_story: As a campaign manager, I want a named owner and testable acceptance criteria so that production handoff decisions are explicit.
acceptance_criteria: Every brief names one human approval owner
Every included requirement has at least one testable acceptance criterion

prd.release_gate: Human owner approves evidence, scope and acceptance criteria.
